    - Follow-up scheduled in three months.

- Investigations (Latest Note):
    - Lipid panel follow-up conducted, showing LDL at 3.9 mmol/L.

- Medications Prescribed (Latest Note):
    - Amlodipine 5 mg (for blood pressure control).
    - Atorvastatin 20 mg at night (started for lipid management); no muscle pain reported.

- Diagnostics & Trends:
    - Blood pressure was controlled on amlodipine.
    - LDL level was 3.9 mmol/L following the lipid panel follow-up.
